name: lyftium
description: Call LYFTIUM Ethereum Mainnet JSON-RPC with X-Api-Key; rpm plans; fails closed with 503 when tip gate is closed.

api_key.title: Your LYFTIUM API key
api_key.description: Your personal LYFTIUM X-Api-Key from checkout at lyftium.com after you subscribe. Never put the key in a URL query string. This plugin does not provide a key.
